scope: RESEARCH: actual shape progress -> native teacher geometry -> teacher pressure aero -> 3DOF point mass; minimal short rollouts only

reference.source: TeacherDesignSpace.reference: G42 full mirrored native lower-surface projected XY area, fixed for every z

mass.source: configs/vehicle.yaml mass.m (inherited numerical assumption; no mass/CG evidence)

dynamics.propagation_kernel: dynamics.integrator.rk4_interval (unchanged; z evaluated at every RK4 stage time)

shape_scheduler.law: rho_dot=sat(K*(1-rho),-rate,+rate), rho=0 at each new command; exact piecewise solution
shape_scheduler.coordinate_semantics: RESEARCH_SHAPE_COORDINATES; not mechanical actuator degrees of freedom

fixture.name: isolated_dynamic_fixture_W1_h56km
fixture.purpose: Dynamic-chain verification at the verified stage-one working point W1; NOT the 180 s official initial state
fixture.h0_selection: Lowest whole-km altitude with M=15 inside every unchanged configs/vehicle.yaml limit (heat proxy at 55 km exceeds 2.0e6 W/m^2); chosen by the user before any teacher call

assumptions.scale: Teacher program coordinates treated as metres; engineering scale unverified
assumptions.pressure: Teacher local pressure approximation; no viscous, bluntness or validated base drag
assumptions.base: OPEN_BASE, Cp=0 on omitted trailing base
assumptions.thermal: Inherited placeholder heat model and limits
assumptions.attitude: 3DOF point mass, direct alpha; no verified pitching moment or trim
